description: Don't miss the Early Access Release Date Trailer for Cursed Blood, a co-op action hack-and-slash roguelike developed by David Marquardt Studios. author: GameTrailers
description: Get another look at Starfinder: Afterlight in this trailer for the upcoming party-based RPG. A public Beta Playtest is out now via Steam, featuring an introduction to the game with three pre-made characters to choose: Human Soldier, Vesk Envoy, and Shirren Operative. After crash-landing in the Entertainment District of Hivemarket on Akiton, players will meet their first companions and begin investigating the fate of Captain Khali. They can explore this part of the city, interact with the world and experience the turn-based combat system. Starfinder: Afterlight will be available in Early Access on Steam in 2026.
title: Starfinder: Afterlight - Official Public Beta Playtest Trailer

description: Knowing is only half the battle! Check out gameplay from The Quizard's Domain in this trailer for the upcoming hero-based battle quiz for 1-4 players. Trivia night just got way more intense! The Quizard's Domain will be available on Steam in 2027.

author: GameTrailers
description:
The Techland development team takes you behind the scenes of the jam-packed new edition of Dying Light: The Beast, called Dying Light: The Beast Restored Land. It includes the full game, all post-release content, and new Restored Land content. In that new Restored Land content, neither enemies nor loot respawn and thus the world is persistent. Killing all zombies in an area restores the map to its pre-apocalyptic state. Plus, there are competitive vehicular challenges called Roadkill Rallies, an optional One Life option for Restored Land that wipes your save file if you die.

Dying Light: The Beast Restored Land launches on March 26 and is free for existing players of Dying Light: The Beast.
title: Dying Light: The Beast Restored Land Edition – Official Behind-the-Scenes Trailer

Dirge of Cerberus Chapter 2 for Final Fantasy Ever Crisis launches on March 25 for iOS, Android, and PC.
title: Final Fantasy 7 Ever Crisis - Official Dirge of Cerberus Chapter 2 Trailer
